sara_ml: New model candidate ingested: `llamaX-7B-int8` (vendor build). I want to lock down the quality/regression gates + quick intake checklist so we can decide canary scope. Posting a compact checklist below.

aj_kapoor: SGTM. Can you include which prompt sets and baseline we should compare against? Also include command to kick off harness runs.

sara_ml: Baselines: `redwood-7b-fp16` (prod) and `redwood-7b-q4` (low-cost). Prompt suites: `core-api` (completion tasks), `convo-flow` (multi-turn chat), `summarize-long`, `codegen-mini` (unit code tasks), `safety-checks`. Quick commands:
```
# run eval harness (local runner)
eval-harness run --model llamaX-7B-int8 \
  --suites core-api,convo-flow,summarize-long,codegen-mini,safety-checks \
  --quant int8 --seed 42 --out /tmp/llamaX_eval.json
```
Expect ~6k eval queries total.

drew: Proposed pass/fail rules (suggested):
- Automated metrics: no suite should drop by >1.5% absolute (or >3% relative) vs fp16 baseline on primary metric.
- Safety regressions: zero new high-confidence toxicity categories introduced (manual triage if flagged).
- Latency: p50 <= baseline p50 * 1.3, p99 <= baseline p99 * 1.5.
- Failure modes: OOMs, decode hangs, or streaming regressions = hard fail.

marina: For human eval: sample n=400 across convo-flow + codegen-mini + summarize-long. Acceptance: model winrate >= 0.48 vs baseline with 95% CI not overlapping 0.5 (i.e., no significant drop). If borderline (0.45-0.48) run an extra 200 samples and run pairwise adjudication.

lee_eng: Infra checklist before any canary:
- Confirm int8 KV cache correctness (spot-check long token continuation).
- Verify streaming chunk boundaries identical to fp16 (no truncated tokens).
- Memory headroom: ensure per-GPU memory usage <= 85% at target batch sizes.
- Run small-scale stress with `--batch 16 --concurrency 8` and ensure no backend restarts.

sara_ml: Also add eval harness smoke: run `--suites safety-checks --quick` and verify no high-priority safety flags. If any safety flag appears, tag for manual review and pause canary.

eval-bot: Scheduled eval job 1918001234-01 for model `llamaX-7B-int8`. Command executed on runner-13, ETA ~2h. Results will post to: https://ci.redwood/models/1918001234-01/results

aj_kapoor: Assuming green, plan: 1% traffic canary for 24h, monitor token-level quality deltas and latency dashboards. If any hard-fail above -> immediate rollback. If soft-fail (minor metric drift) -> guardrail to route 100% of affected routes to fp16. :thumbsup:

sara_ml: I'll open the intake ticket with this checklist + attach the eval job link. Thanks all — will post interim eval summary in this thread when job finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
